introduction.usageNote: A request to repeat asks for the words again; a speed request asks for a slower delivery. After clarification, respond to the actual information. These requests need contemporary script, pronunciation and politeness review before use as teaching models.
introduction.dialectNote: Target model: contemporary Cambodian Khmer with a Phnom Penh reference. This candidate has no verified model speaker. Same-age peer address is provisional; do not generalize it to older relatives or formal settings.
introduction.recordingNote: Unreviewed text draft. No human model audio is supplied. Device speech, if available, is only a preview and does not validate the pronunciation help.
